description: Use this when the user wants to see, check or talk about a Brilliant design opened in this conversation: it returns the element tree as Blueprint rows with ids (the ids rows can target), how each turn of the design ended (complete, halted, stopped at a limit, or still building) and any rows that did not apply. With wait, it holds up to 25 seconds for the design's latest turn to end; a turn still building at that point answers its progress. A design renders once the user has the canvas open in the chat.

seed.description: The design's slug (from the design result).

wait.description: true holds the answer up to 25 seconds for the design's latest turn to end. Default false.

name: inspect_design
title: See a Brilliant design
